content.transcript: Public parks can support exercise, social contact, and cooling in hot weather. However, parks are most useful when people can reach them safely and when paths, lighting, seating, and vegetation are maintained.

options.A: Parks provide several benefits, but accessibility and maintenance affect how useful they are.
options.B: Parks are valuable only because they contain sports fields.
options.C: Maintenance has no effect on how people use parks.
